bio.text: Matt Van Epps represents Tennessee's 7th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, sworn in on December 4 following a special election.
A graduate of the U.S. Military Academy at West Point, he served ten years on active duty as an Army aviator, then in the Tennessee Army National Guard, rising to Lieutenant Colonel.

He was Deputy Chief Operating Officer in the Governor's Office and Commissioner of the Tennessee Department of General Services, and holds a Master of Public Administration from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.
He lives in Nashville with his wife and child.
